fields.title: 📖 What counts are deeds and words
fields.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Idrīs ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Allah has pardoned what is in the hearts, and deeds and words were recorded for people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A person is not burdened with mere inner thoughts, so long as they do not become **word** or **deed**. In this lies mercy — and at the same time responsibility for ***speech and action***.

immutable.source: 📝 adh-Dhahabī, Siyar Aʿlām an-Nubalāʾ, Tarjamat ash-Shāfiʿī, Band 10, S. 33.
